name: Founders Circle
description: Holds the founding vision and final say while the village grows into governing itself. Can open and decide proposals, consent to quests, and moderate the forum.

name: Steward Circle
description: Village Stewards coordinating the land and the work. Can consent to quests and propose new ones.

name: Treasury
description: Keeps the money legible: tracks budgets and allocations, and carries the cycle report to Hypha where Amora and Voice are governed.

name: Trained Practitioners
description: Members trained for work that needs it (machinery, earthworks, medicine). Some quests require this role.
